tasks.short: Analyze relationships and interpret statistical differences.

steps.what: Identify actual research question, datasets, populations and relevant statistical assumptions
inputs: actual dataset versions and collection documentation

steps.what: Prepare analysis data and execute chosen statistical comparisons in statistical analysis software {OTHER}
Analyze and interpret statistical data and significant differences among information sources
outputs: actual interpretation, uncertainty and source-comparability findings

steps.what: Record and check final analysis choices, limitations and interpretation
inputs: actual interpretation, uncertainty and source-comparability findings

steps.what: Save the checked final statistical analysis record

tasks.design: Configure native reusable transformations and comparison routines in statistical analysis software {OTHER}, reading versioned data from {DATA_PLATFORM}. The statistician chooses methods, checks diagnostics and interprets differences, then records and saves the final analysis.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated manual setup and data reshaping can interrupt analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reproducible routines can reuse explicit transformation and comparison specifications.
tasks.still_hard: Significance, comparability, confounding and uncertainty require statistical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The statistician recognises when an apparent relationship is unsupported by the design.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated analysis setup; interpretation remains human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native statistical scripts can reuse explicit transformations and comparisons; they do not establish valid methods or interpretation.

assumptions: Actual dataset owners supply data version, variable definitions, population and collection records. Statistician verifies these and chooses methods in s1; retained s2 covers new specifications, data exceptions and diagnostic checks.
Only repeated manual setup/reshaping is reduced. Existing scripted calculations and machine runtime earn zero saving. No automatic method selection or invented clean dataset is assumed.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native routines first. Record capture and complete check remain retained; routine save is one percent and uses the existing final check. Reporting under 8953 is counted separately once.
unknowns: How much setup is still manual?
research_questions: Can native reusable routines remove repeated setup without weakening diagnostic checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual transformation specifications and regression checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final analysis record and exact project destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 35*0.40 repeated setup = 14; minus 1.5 upkeep = 12.5. Half eligible gives 7 minus 1.5 = 5.5. Method choice, interpretation, record check and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate statistical methods and data collection procedures.

steps.what: Find actual statistical methods, procedures and collection documentation with linked source versions
inputs: actual analysis specifications and data provenance

steps.what: Evaluate statistical methods and procedures for validity, applicability, efficiency and accuracy
inputs: actual evaluation criteria and intended use

steps.what: Write and check actual methodological evaluation findings and supporting source references
Save the checked final methodological evaluation record

tasks.design: Configure native version and provenance links in {DOCS} and {DATA_PLATFORM}. The statistician reads actual evidence, performs the methodological evaluation using statistical software {OTHER} when needed, and records checked findings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Method review can repeat navigation between protocols and data provenance.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source/version links can reduce navigation while preserving original evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Methodological validity depends on actual collection and intended use.
tasks.human_edge: The statistician detects an efficient procedure that produces invalid inference.
tasks.altitude: Less evidence navigation; method evaluation stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document/provenance links can shorten evidence retrieval; validity and applicability still require statistical assessment.

assumptions: Actual study/data owners produce protocols, collection records and specifications; source selection and checking remain in s1. Missing collection evidence cannot be inferred.
S2 includes actual diagnostic or replication checks where required; existing computational runtime earns no saving. Actual findings capture and final review remain fully retained.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native links first; existing linked access earns zero saving. Save retains one percent and consumes the existing final check. Any separate external report uses task 8953, counted once.
research_questions: Do native provenance links reduce retrieval while preserving complete method review?

incremental.description: Maintain actual protocol and provenance version links.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final method evaluation record and exact project destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 25*0.40 source navigation = 10; minus 0.5 upkeep = 9.5. Half eligible gives 5 minus 0.5 = 4.5. Evaluation, record writing and save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Report statistical results with graphs, charts and tables.

steps.what: Select actual analysis results, intended audience, uncertainty and reporting requirements
inputs: actual checked analysis results and diagnostics
outputs: chosen report content and exact result references

steps.what: Prepare graphs, charts and tables from chosen results in statistical reporting software {OTHER}
inputs: chosen report content and exact result references
outputs: draft result-linked graphs, charts and tables

steps.what: Write statistical report explanations and limitations from actual interpretation
inputs: chosen report content and exact result references
draft result-linked graphs, charts and tables

loop.purpose: Draft reporting prose from actual statistical interpretation
loop.input: Chosen result references, figures and actual statistician interpretation
loop.output: Report prose with source-linked numerical statements
loop.check: Statistician checks effect meaning, uncertainty, causality, missing limitations and every result reference
loop.stop: Missing interpretation or two failed revisions returns prose to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native figure/table templates first; explanations and limitations vary

steps.what: Check final report, graphs, charts and tables against results and disclosure permissions
inputs: actual checked analysis results and diagnostics
outputs: checked final report and exact permitted recipient list

steps.what: Save the checked final statistical report
inputs: checked final report and exact permitted recipient list

steps.what: Send the exact checked statistical report to authorised recipients
inputs: checked final report and exact permitted recipient list

tasks.design: Configure native result-linked figure/table templates in statistical reporting software {OTHER}, then bound prose drafting in {DOCS} to actual interpretations. The statistician checks complete numerical and substantive meaning, saves the final report and separately sends the exact authorised version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Report production can repeat figure formatting and explanatory prose after analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reproducible figure/table assembly and bounded prose drafting can reduce production.
tasks.still_hard: Clear uncertainty, correct interpretation and disclosure permissions require complete review.
tasks.human_edge: The statistician recognises a misleading visual or unsupported inference despite correct numbers.
tasks.altitude: Less report assembly; statistical meaning and release decisions stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: statistical reporting software can reuse figure/table templates, and bounded prose drafting can express supplied interpretations; neither establishes statistical validity.

assumptions: Statistician produces actual checked results in analysis work and selects content in s1. S2 retains new visual specification, exceptions and checks; s3 retains capture/correction of actual interpretation. No invented result or free interpretation input.
Only repeated manual formatting and prose lose time. Existing automated tables, plots and computational runtime earn zero saving. Full numerical/substantive review in s4 stays retained.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native reporting templates first; shared analysis/interpretation is counted once under 8956. Only actual reports/deliveries are included and oral reporting requires reweighting.

Routine save and send each retain one percent; gates consume the existing final check after complete report exists. If another actual disclosure owner must approve, final version goes to that owner before release; no avoided approval labour claimed.
research_questions: Does assembly and prose drafting reduce time after complete statistical and disclosure review?

already_counted.description: Capture and correct actual report meaning in s3.

incremental.description: Maintain actual reporting specifications, source links and prose checks.

s4 checked final report and exact permitted recipient list; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 30*0.50 formatting + 20*0.30 prose = 21; minus 1.5 upkeep = 19.5. Half eligible gives 10.5 minus 1.5 = 9. All content choices, final checks, save and send retained.

tasks.short: Determine statistical method suitability for user needs.

steps.what: Clarify actual user needs, intended inference and available data through discussion
inputs: actual user question and intended decisions
outputs: actual agreed analytical question and constraints

steps.what: Retrieve actual design, variable definitions and candidate method references
inputs: actual agreed analytical question and constraints
actual study design and variable documentation

steps.what: Determine whether statistical methods are appropriate for actual user needs and assumptions
inputs: actual agreed analytical question and constraints

steps.what: Record and check actual method choice, assumptions and unresolved user constraints
Save the checked final method-choice record

tasks.design: Configure native study and method-reference links in {DOCS} and {DATA_PLATFORM}. The statistician clarifies actual needs, assesses suitability using statistical analysis software {OTHER} if needed, and records the checked choice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Suitability work can repeat navigation through design and method references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked references can shorten navigation without selecting a method automatically.
tasks.still_hard: User intent, assumptions and inference trade-offs require professional judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The statistician identifies when the requested conclusion cannot follow from available data.
tasks.altitude: Less reference navigation; user clarification and method choice stay human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native study/reference links can support method-evidence retrieval; they do not determine statistical suitability.

assumptions: Actual users supply intended questions in s1; actual study owners supply design and variable definitions, checked in s2. No free structured requirements or automatic suitability decision is assumed.

Discussion, method reasoning, record capture and final check remain retained. No separate digital send is specified; any actual written recommendation delivery must be split and final-version gated separately.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native links first; existing linked reference access earns zero saving. Routine save retains one percent and uses the existing final check. Shared method decisions are counted once if used under 8956 or 8958.
research_questions: Can native references reduce retrieval while preserving full suitability assessment?

incremental.description: Maintain actual study and method-reference links.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final method-choice record and exact project destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.40 reference navigation = 8; minus 0.5 upkeep = 7.5. Half eligible gives 4 minus 0.5 = 3.5. Discussion, suitability judgement, record writing and save retained.

role.altitude: Statisticians retain method choice and interpretation while repeated setup and reporting may shrink.
